intent: In packages/agent-scheduler/src/run.LOGIC.md, the section 'The checkout' says that when a run names a follow-up its checkout is 'put under the hold [12]' and that a hold that cannot be put fails the run with 'could not hold the merge'. The code has no such hold: run.ts only adds the line HOLD_MERGE_LINE to the agent's prompt (described under 'The follow-up'), and glossary item [12] is the git host. Remove those sentences from 'The checkout' so the file says what the code does, and change nothing else. Commit, push your branch and open its pull request.
